children: Zedge entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement to raise $7.675 million through a private placement of 2,616,447 Class B shares and warrants to purchase 2,354,803 additional shares. Purchasers include Vice Chairman Howard Jonas, director Elliot Gibber, and another existing stockholder. Shares were priced at the prior-day close ($2.93–$2.98), with 90% warrant coverage; warrants are exercisable at 110% of the purchase price and become exercisable after the later of six months and stockholder approval under NYSE American rules. The securities were sold without a placement agent under Sections 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b).
